title: Time/cost saved is a counterfactual ESTIMATE, never measured against her manual baseline or the 60-70% screening cut
expected: A MEASURED time/cost saving against the manual baseline she defends upward (~23h screening/hire, ~13h sourcing/role; 60-70% screening-time cut), in hours and CZK leadership accepts.
got: The ROI ledger headline (analytics.roi.headline) is Sum(count x flat MINUTES_SAVED_PER_KIND) / 60 x rate (default 600 CZK/h). Per-action minutes are hand-set and override-able (honest), grounded in the real event trail, but there is NO computation of a percentage cut against any baseline. Nothing surfaces 'X% of screening time eliminated'.
l2_priority: With seeded automation events, confirm the live ROI figure renders, then confirm there is still no baseline-relative screening-cut metric; judge whether the CZK/hours figure is defensible to leadership without it.
suggested_acceptance: Surface a measured screening-time reduction vs a stated manual baseline (e.g. 'screening time cut N% vs ~23h/hire'), with the baseline editable and shown, so the 60-70% promise is verifiable, not an assumption.

title: No single leadership-ready ROI readout tying automation savings -> cost-per-hire -> time-to-fill into one defensible export
expected: One consolidated, exportable 'the AI paid for itself' readout she'd put her name on: automation savings, cost-per-hire, and time-to-fill movement combined into a board-ready figure.
got: The pieces are scattered across separate panels: automation %/ROI hours-CZK in one panel, cost-per-hire several panels lower in the channel-economics table, calibration in another panel, time-to-hire in the top-right stat cluster. CSV exports are per-panel (roles, ROI ledger, decision dossier) but there is no single combined ROI/payback view.
l2_priority: Confirm live there is no consolidated ROI/payback view or single combined export; assess whether a senior would assemble the slide from these scattered panels or reject it as below her own spreadsheet.
suggested_acceptance: Add one ROI/payback panel (and CSV/print export) that combines automation savings, cost-per-hire, and time-to-fill delta into a single leadership-ready readout.

title: Decision-records copy still says 'only auto-rejections' though six decision kinds now seal
expected: Copy that reflects the records actually captured, so the audit trail doesn't read as thinner than it is.
got: The route comment and the cs panel blurb both scope to auto-rejections ('today: the auto-rejections' / 'Kazde automaticke zamitnuti je zapeceteno'), but sealDecisionSafe now writes auto_rejected, offer_terms, reinstated, ai_scorecard, human_scorecard and group_eval_lead. The copy under-sells the feature.
l2_priority: Confirm live that the records panel shows non-auto_rejected kinds (e.g. offer_terms) yet the blurb still names only rejections.
suggested_acceptance: Update the records route comment and the cs/en blurb to describe all sealed decision kinds, not only auto-rejections.

title: Calibration is genuinely MEASURED with an honest under-data gate
expected: Confidence scores presented with a calibration basis (predicted vs actual outcome), not as bare fact.
got: computeCalibration bins real (score, disposition-outcome) pairs into a reliability curve + Brier score, gated at MIN_CALIBRATION_OUTCOMES=20; below the gate the panel refuses a curve and states how many more outcomes are needed. Ambiguous 'hold'/undecided rows are excluded. ?roleFamily filters per family. Exactly the calibration view her senior bar demands; defuses her #1 pet peeve.
l2_priority: With seeded outcomes, assert the curve renders from real pairs and the 'calibrated since N' gate is honest (under-data -> says so, no fake curve).
suggested_acceptance: Protect this: never replace the measured calibration + honest gate with a vanity 'accuracy %'.

title: Cost-per-hire has real per-hire attribution with honest nulling
expected: Spend shown with per-hire attribution, not a lump total.
got: costPerHireCzk = spendCzk / hired and costPerApplicantCzk = spendCzk / total, computed per inbound channel, nulled when no spend / zero hires (no infinity) / windowed cohort vs lifetime spend. This is true per-hire attribution, not a budget total.
l2_priority: Confirm per-hire spend resolves to attributed hires live and the CSV export matches the on-screen figures.
suggested_acceptance: Keep the honest nulling; do not paper over zero-hire/windowed cases with a misleading number.

title: Tamper-evident decision records + auto/human-attributed decision log on the analytics surface
expected: Decision logs (what/by whom/cost) accessible from the analytics surface.
got: DecisionLog (paginated, exportable, auto/human-attributed) and DecisionRecordsPanel (hash-chained, verify badge, dossier export) are siblings on the Analytics tab. Records capture actor, policyVersion, rationale and the decisive inputs.
l2_priority: Confirm a real sealed entry with basis + actor renders and the verify badge is green.
suggested_acceptance: Keep the records accessible directly from Analytics; don't bury the audit trail behind a separate tab.

title: Match score basis is legible (per-dimension breakdown + banded confidence) and ties to the calibration panel
expected: The score's basis is legible (per-dimension breakdown), not a number she can't calibrate against outcomes.
got: Each MatchCard renders a per-dimension ScoreBreakdown plus a confidence band with named drivers, not a bare number; the aggregate reliability of those scores is the calibration panel on Analytics.
l2_priority: Confirm the breakdown + band render live and read clearly to a non-recruiter analytics owner.
suggested_acceptance: Keep the per-dimension breakdown and banded (not point) confidence.

title: AI-vs-rule-based reasoning provenance is disclosed in the UI (degrade seam is honest)
expected: A deterministic-template fallback (past allowance or missing key) disclosed as 'template, not AI-reasoned'.
got: runReasoning pushes --no-llm past the ai_candidates allowance, and the UI labels the result source === 'llm' ? 'LLM' : 'pravidlove' with an optional cached suffix. A template verdict is never laundered as AI.
l2_priority: Confirm the rule-based label actually shows on a keyless/over-allowance run.
suggested_acceptance: Keep the explicit LLM-vs-rule-based provenance badge on every reasoning verdict.

title: No link from a candidate's confidence band to the aggregate calibration of that score
expected: From an individual pick's confidence band, a way to see 'here's how calibrated a 90 actually is' (the calibration panel).
got: The per-candidate score basis lives on the Match card; the aggregate calibration of those scores lives on the Analytics tab, with no cross-link closing the loop between an individual pick and the proven reliability of the score behind it.
l2_priority: Low priority; confirm there is no navigation between a match confidence band and the calibration panel.
suggested_acceptance: Optionally link a candidate's confidence band to the calibration view filtered to that role family.
